_comment: Fixed per model and backend class. Cosines are true cosines (norms are checked separately) and every backend L2-normalises in F32. Measured 2026-10-19 on M3 Max against the fixtures (worst case over alone + batch runs): metal/bf16 embed min 0.99971 mean 0.99979; coreml embed min 0.99955 mean 0.99965; metal/bf16 LI token min 0.99921 (lateon-code) / 0.99982 (edge), mean >= 0.99991, MaxSim rel <= 9.84e-3; coreml LI token min 0.99921 (shapes no variant fits run on candle Metal), mean >= 0.99994, MaxSim rel <= 3.6e-3; f32 on cpu and metal: cosine 1.000000, MaxSim rel <= 1e-6. Earlier bounds (min ~0.99) measured dot products of BF16-normalised vectors whose norms were up to ~0.8% off 1. Classes not listed have no tolerances and fail until measured. Do not loosen to make a run pass; a failure means the output changed.
